description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A radiologist needs to compare bone and soft-tissue structures for a pre-treatment review. Create two separate segmentation masks: one for bone (using a bone Hounsfield Unit threshold, e.g. the Bone preset 226–3071 HU) and one for soft tissue (using an appropriate soft tissue threshold, e.g. the Soft Tissue preset −700 to 225 HU or Muscle Tissue −5 to 135 HU). After creating both masks, save the InVesalius project to /home/ga/Documents/tissue_comparison.inv3 so that both masks are preserved for later review. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
